findings.statement: A durable load's device bytes are dominated by writes the engine never made explicitly
findings.detail: 161.4 MB reach the device; the explicit per-region ledger accounts for 110.8 MB and the residual -- mmap-dirtied pages flushed under fsync, plus filesystem metadata -- is 31.3%. The lever this names is not writing fewer bytes; it is scoping the durability point so fsync stops flushing every scattered 4KiB index page the batch dirtied

notes: arms interleaved in one process; every key is new (the EXT.9 shape)
regions are explicit write_all_at bytes attributed at the call site; residual = /proc/self/io write_bytes minus the ledger sum, i.e. mmap writeback under fsync plus filesystem metadata
